name: com.vakaymood/inventory
title: VakayMood
description: Live timeshare rental stays at resorts: availability, pricing, listing and resort details.

tools.name: search_availability
tools.description: Searches publicly visible timeshare rental stays on vakaymood.com by place, resort, date window, sleeping capacity, nightly price and brand. Returns stays with fixed dates, itemized pricing in USD and the vakaymood.com URL where each stay is booked. All parameters are optional and combinable. Each result is a summary: the bed configuration, kitchen equipment, cancellation terms, VakayFlex option, notices, unit amenities and unit policies of a stay are returned by get_listing for its listingId, and the policies and published questions and answers of its resort by get_resort for its resort.id.

location.description: Free-form place name, matched against resort country, state and city. Example: Orlando Florida.

resort.description: One resort, given as an RR code (RR12345678) or a resort slug from a previous result.

checkin.description: Start of the search window, YYYY-MM-DD.

checkout.description: End of the search window, YYYY-MM-DD.

max_nightly_price.description: Upper bound on the nightly rate in USD.

sort.description: Result ordering. start_asc (default) orders by check-in date, then nightly price.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Returns the full detail of one publicly visible stay: unit type, bed configuration, fixed check-in and check-out dates, itemized pricing in USD, standard cancellation terms, the optional VakayFlex cancellation upgrade with its fee and guaranteed refund, notices such as a parking charge or renovation work, unit amenities such as kitchen equipment, unit policies, resort amenities and the vakaymood.com URL where it is booked. A stay that is no longer publicly visible is reported as not found.

listing_id.description: Listing VK code (VK04437967), as returned in listingId, or a listing slug from a bookingUrl.

tools.name: get_resort
tools.description: Returns one resort: address, coordinates, amenities, unit types, policies, its page on vakaymood.com and its published questions and answers, which cover topics such as parking and its cost.

resort.description: Resort RR code (RR12345678), as returned in resort.id, or a resort slug from a previous result.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: Returns every published VakayMood collection: a curated group of resorts (a destination, a brand, a price cap or a season) with its current starting nightly price in USD and its page on vakaymood.com. The slug of each collection identifies it in get_collection.

tools.name: get_collection
tools.description: Returns one published collection: its editorial as sanitized HTML, published questions and answers, member resorts with their vakaymood.com pages and starting nightly prices, and its lowest priced available stays in ascending price order.

slug.description: Collection slug, as returned by list_collections.

limit.description: Number of lowest priced stays to return. Default 10.
